description: Hi! We’re Jatin ,Harsh and Ahmad, a team from India joining NASA Space Apps. I (Jatin) am a B.Tech CSE-AI/ML student (University of Lucknow), RIFT 2026 and Google Techathon 2025 winner, skilled in Python, FastAPI, Kubernetes, geospatial data (QGIS) and ML, including a physics-informed model for solar CME prediction. We’re looking for teammates in data science, Earth-observation analysis, UI design or storytelling. Join us!
